desc: Analyze the problem and devise a greedy bottom-up DFS strategy.
Implement the DFS function as described.
Handle leaf nodes correctly (return 1 if K>1, 0 if K=1).
At each node, collect pending lengths from children, add 1, and filter.
Enforce that at most 2 segments are pending at any node.
Merge 2 segments if possible, check if sum is K or < K.
Return 0 if root has no pending path, else No.
Read input, build adjacency list, run DFS from root 1.
Check the result of DFS(1) and print "Yes" or "No".
